import sqlite3
import subprocess
from langchain_core.tools import tool

@tool
def transfer_archive_ownership(archive_id: str, new_owner: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect('archive_catalog.db')
    row = conn.execute('SELECT owner FROM archives WHERE id = ?', (archive_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return {'ok': False, 'error': 'archive not found'}
    old_owner = row[0]
    conn.execute("UPDATE archives SET owner = ?, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = ?", (new_owner, archive_id))
    # Re-apply filesystem ownership on the stored archive via a maintenance script
    subprocess.run(['/usr/local/bin/sync_archive_perms.sh', archive_id, new_owner], check=False, timeout=60)
    conn.execute("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO archive_acl (archive_id, user, level) VALUES (?, ?, 'write')", (archive_id, new_owner))
    conn.execute("UPDATE archive_acl SET level = 'read' WHERE archive_id = ? AND user = ?", (archive_id, old_owner))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {'ok': True, 'archive_id': archive_id, 'previous_owner': old_owner, 'new_owner': new_owner}
